sources.name: Massachusetts Property Tax Parcels (MassGIS Level 3)
sources.operator: MassGIS (Bureau of Geographic Information), Commonwealth of Massachusetts
sources.scope: MassGIS Level 3 standardized assessor parcel polygons for all 351 Massachusetts cities and towns (2,559,636 rows on 2026-10-12), identified by the MassGIS LOC_ID locational parcel identifier. All published POLY_TYPE values are included; the one row without a LOC_ID is excluded.
caveats: The layer joins polygons to assessing records, so one LOC_ID repeats once per assessing record with byte-identical geometry (up to 865 rows in Boston); the adapter keeps one polygon per LOC_ID. No LOC_ID with differing Shape__Area was found in Boston, Worcester or Springfield.
MAP_PAR_ID is a town-scoped assessor map-parcel label used only for display; it is blank on some polygons.
Non-FEE polygon types (TAX 63,180, PRIV_ROW 832, RAIL_ROW 530, ROW 232, WATER 73 rows) are included; sampled TAX, PRIV_ROW and WATER polygons did not overlap FEE polygons.
Publisher text: standardization is complete for 350 of 351 communities and Boston is processed separately; Boston (TOWN_ID 35) rows are present in this layer.
metricSrid 32619 suits eastern Massachusetts; cities west of 72 W (e.g. Springfield) need 32618 when qualified.
